title: Concept: Spring Actuator thread dump
description: A Spring Actuator threads document in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The dump lists every thread with its stack, which names internal classes, libraries and sometimes the queries or URLs a thread is processing.
applicability: Deployments that render a Spring Actuator threads document into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The dump lists every thread with its stack, which names internal classes, libraries and sometimes the queries or URLs a thread is processing.
